objective_for_doctor: Assess and diagnose the young patient presenting with wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions.

turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Hi doctor—I'm a 17-year-old male. For the last three days I’ve had worsening pain in my left wrist, and this morning it got worse along with chills and feeling really run-down; I also noticed painless purple bumps/blisters on both wrists and hands and my left wrist is swollen and very tender to touch or movement.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—such as twitching, jerking, shaking, or uncontrollable movements that you can’t stop? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No—doctor, I haven’t noticed any twitching, jerking, shaking, or any uncontrolled movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves or shifts** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast or any shifting/moving there.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—when you press or tap around my belly button area, it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t been vomiting. I’ve mainly just had the worsening left wrist pain, chills, and feeling run-down, plus those painless purple bumps/blisters on my wrists and hands.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (for example, a new or growing area you can feel)?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, and there’s been no pain or noticeable change there.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you notice that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, like you’re seeing through a fogged window? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any cloudiness or haze in either eye, and my vision seems the same.”

turns.doctor_question: In the past few months, have you lost weight without trying (for example, your clothes fit looser or the scale went down), even though you didn’t change your diet or exercise?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t lost weight without trying, and my diet and activity haven’t changed.”
